name: When does it make sense to invest in a primary suite addition?
description: An addition makes sense when your family needs more space, your existing master bath is outdated or small, or you want accessible main-floor living.

mainEntity.name: When does it make sense to invest in a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners often choose a primary suite addition when their household outgrows existing bedroom layouts or when they need accessible main-floor living. If your current master bedroom lacks closet space or private bath facilities, adding an expansive suite resolves daily friction. It is also an ideal solution for homeowners preparing to age in place who want zero-threshold walk-in showers and wider doorways, or those creating dedicated multigenerational suites while keeping the rest of the home intact for other family members.
acceptedAnswer.description: An addition makes sense when your family needs more space, your existing master bath is outdated or small, or you want accessible main-floor living.
